audience: support teams who work a shared inbox in SupportBee

useCases.title: Find tickets by assignee, label, requester or text
useCases.text: The AI lists tickets with filters for assignee, team, label, requester and dates, or searches subject, body and requester text, and summarizes what is open.

useCases.title: Read a ticket with its replies, comments and history
useCases.text: The AI reads the ticket, the public replies, the internal comments and the audit trail of assignments, label changes and archiving.

useCases.title: Check ticket counts and first response time
useCases.text: The AI reads report data points over time for tickets, replies or average first response time, for one agent, team or label.

useCases.title: Reply to a ticket or add an internal comment
useCases.text: The AI sends a public reply by email to the requester, or adds a comment that only agents see. It can reuse a canned reply.

useCases.title: Add or remove labels, assign or archive tickets
useCases.text: The AI adds or removes labels, assigns a ticket to one agent or one team, and archives a ticket so it leaves the open inbox.

useCases.title: Find a canned reply for a ticket
useCases.text: The AI lists the canned replies (snippets) with name, tags and text and picks one that fits the ticket you describe.
